item.title: Blackbaud Reports Operating Margin Of 16.9%
item.description: (image from blackbaud.com) Social impact tech firm Blackbaud generated generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) total revenue of $1.1 billion for 2025, down 2.3%, the decline driven by its divestiture of education platform EVERFI. Blackbaud reported its non-GAAP organic revenue increased 5.5%. item.title: New Report Shows Philanthropy Has A Pulse
item.description: Nonprofits with boards that prioritize personal giving reported revenue growth during 2025. When expectations are specified to board members, they most often involve personal financial contribution — either alone or combined with fundraising.
